Best for instant, bulk parsing. Retrieves clean, stripped page text optimized for LLM token windows.

Part of [`seek scrape`](seek-scrape.md).

## Usage

```text
seek scrape exa [options] <urls...>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls...` | Yes, one or more | One or more URLs to fetch |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-c, --chars <n>` | Max characters per page | `50000` |
| `--json` | Emit raw JSON response |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek scrape exa` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek scrape exa --help`:

```text

Best for instant, bulk parsing. Retrieves clean, stripped page text optimized
for LLM token windows.

Arguments:
  urls             One or more URLs to fetch

Options:
  -c, --chars <n>  Max characters per page (default: 50000)
  --json           Emit raw JSON response
  -h, --help       display help for command
```
